issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: stone_slab, cauldron.
39 blocks, over the prop budget of 30 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.

visual.summary: Fire pit level 2: adds a cauldron, crates, a chopping block and stepping stones; a lived-in cooking spot.
problems: Level 1 is bare round the edges (no plants); the log benches are pale stripped birch that doesn't match the dark timber of the other buildings: spruce or oak logs.
Level 3 only adds red carpets on the benches and a few plants over level 2: give it its own feature (a cooking pot on a tripod, a woodpile shelter).
